verses.t: At Sāvatthī. Standing to one side, that deity spoke this verse in the Buddha’s presence:
“Children bring you delight! Cattle also bring you delight! For attachments are a man’s delight; without attachments there’s no delight.”
“Children bring you sorrow. Cattle also bring you sorrow. For attachments are a man’s sorrow; without attachments there are no sorrows.”
